info.name: Orebit Chat — User API
info.description:
Chat HTTP routes of the user backend (default http://localhost:3005). Sign in first with the "0. Sign in" request: it stores the `orebit_session` cookie in Postman's cookie jar and the CSRF token in `csrfToken`. Every POST/PUT sends `x-orebit-csrf`. Set `roomId` (a room id or slug), `messageId` and `userId` in the collection variables. There is no bearer token. The socket is documented in `orebit-chat-socket.testing-guide.json`.

Generated from the chat section of openapi.json; tests/social/chat.openapi.spec.ts checks that every chat route is here.

request.description: The `captchaToken` above is Cloudflare's always-pass test token and only works with the Turnstile test keys of the development `.env`. A browser answer of `outcome: "session"` sets the `orebit_session` and `orebit_csrf` cookies; `mfa_required` means finish with `POST /auth/2fa/verify` first.

item.name: GET /social/chat/rooms — List the rooms the user may see

request.description: The lobby. Hidden rooms are not listed; closed rooms come with `accessMode`, `reason` and `requirement` so the app can say what is needed. `onlineCount` is live. Also returns `gifProvider`.
The rules the admin wrote for this room; `[]` when there are none.
Count, a page of members, a cursor and a username-prefix search. Not pushed over the socket; ask when the member list is opened.
Newest first, paged with `cursor`. To catch up after a dropped connection pass `after=<id of the last message you had>`: you get the newer messages oldest first (not together with `cursor`).
Pinned messages

item.name: POST /social/chat/messages/media — Send a media message over HTTP

request.description: Same path as the socket `send_message`: same limits, access and moderation; delivered to open sockets the same way. Upload the file first with `POST /social/chat/upload`, or use a GIF URL from the configured provider.

exec: const m = pm.response.json(); if (m.data && m.data.messageId) pm.collectionVariables.set('messageId', m.data.messageId);

request.description: Authors within the retract window, and staff. The message is kept for staff and shown retracted to everyone else.
Messages that @mention the user, only from rooms the user may view now.
Profile card
Also tells the app which room to open (`effectiveDefaultRoomId`). The last room is remembered on the server; `lastRoomId` is only a fallback hint from the browser.
Change my chat preferences

item.name: GET /social/chat/skins — Skins the user may use

request.description: Skins the user may use
Never shows who issued a warning.
Your own bans, restrictions, refused or cancelled ads and reverted gifts. Only the reason written for you.
Report a user
Report a message

item.name: GET /social/chat/report-reasons — Reasons a report can give

request.description: Edited by the admin; use the `code` in the report body.
Moderators and above. Cannot act on a user of equal or higher rank.
Give `durationHours` (1 to the setting `limits.maxBanHours`) or `permanent: true`. The end time is set by the database clock.
Pin a message (chat staff)
Unpin a message (chat staff)

Multipart form with one `file` field. Types and size come from the chat settings (`uploads`). Pass `?roomId=` so a room that does not allow images refuses it before anything is stored. Answers the chat media URL to put in `mediaUrl`.

item.name: GET /social/chat/media/{mediaId} — An uploaded file, by its signed link

request.description:
Public: no session cookie. Valid only with the `exp` and `sig` of a link chat handed out with a message you may view. Served with its stored type, `nosniff`; `410` when an admin removed it.

Paste a full signed link (with `exp` and `sig`) from a message into the URL to try it.
The signed-in staff member's role, each permission with ACT / REPORT / NONE, the ban maximum, penalty scope, history days, pin and rules rooms, restrictable commands and the roles they may give.

item.name: POST /social/chat/staff/restrict — Restrict a user or a group

request.description: Chat SETTINGS "Restrict a Specific User / Group of Users": MUTE, RESTRICT_MEDIA / EMOJI / GIF / COMMANDS / ADS / DM / GIFTS / RECEIVE_GIFTS, chat-wide or in one room, for a time or until lifted. Groups (PREMIUM, KYC, LEVEL) need the role's group privilege. In REPORT mode the answer is `{ requested: true, requestId, permission }`: a higher role (or an admin) decides.

"Change / Remove Penalties … by other Moderation Team", within the role's penalty scope. In REPORT mode the answer is `{ requested: true, requestId, permission }`: a higher role (or an admin) decides.
Within the role's penalty scope; admin-panel bans stay the panel's. In REPORT mode the answer is `{ requested: true, requestId, permission }`: a higher role (or an admin) decides.

"Check Chat Banned / Penalised Users List: Edit": a new end counted from now (`durationHours`, absent or null = until lifted) and optionally a new reason, within the role's penalty scope. In REPORT mode the answer is `{ requested: true, requestId, permission }`: a higher role (or an admin) decides.

A new end counted from now (`durationHours`, at most the role's ban maximum) or `permanent: true` (chat admins only), and optionally a new reason. In REPORT mode the answer is `{ requested: true, requestId, permission }`: a higher role (or an admin) decides.
"See User Stats [even if they are private]": messages, warnings, bans, reports, restrictions, gifts and ads — only the stats the role's `visibleStats` lists.
"Check Bot Log of a User": what automatic moderation did to them, newest first, within the role's history days.

item.name: GET /social/chat/staff/users/{userId}/history — A user's history in other features

request.description: "View User History": the user's activity in other platform features (Faucet, SL…), only the features the chat role may see (empty = all features) and only the role's last x days. Answers `feature_unavailable` until a feature module provides the history.
"See Penalised / Banned Users List": live bans (paged by `before`) and live restrictions.
"See Reported Messages" — public and DM messages. A retracted message's text only with "See Deleted Messages".
"Take Action on Reported Messages": DISMISS, WARN, BAN or RETRACT_MESSAGE, each also needing its own permission; a REPORT-mode action leaves the report open.
"Sort and See all recent messages of a single user" within the role's history days; retracted messages included.

item.name: GET /social/chat/staff/users/{userId}/tags — Messages where a user is tagged

request.description: "See all tags of a user" within the role's history days.
"See Previous Chat (chat history)" within the role's history days, retracted messages included.

item.name: POST /social/chat/staff/rooms/{roomId}/status — Turn a room on, off or into maintenance

request.description: "Disable / Enable Chat Rooms". In REPORT mode the answer is `{ requested: true, requestId, permission }`: a higher role (or an admin) decides.
"Edit Chat Rules (Text)" for the rooms the role covers. In REPORT mode the answer is `{ requested: true, requestId, permission }`: a higher role (or an admin) decides.

item.name: POST /social/chat/staff/rooms/{roomId}/access — Add, remove or restore a user's room access

request.description: "Change chat Room access for user (Remove / Add user from specific rooms)": ADD lets the user in whatever the room's gates say, REMOVE shuts them out, RESTORE undoes either. In REPORT mode the answer is `{ requested: true, requestId, permission }`: a higher role (or an admin) decides.
"Disable Specific Commands from chat" / "Disable All Commands from chat". In REPORT mode the answer is `{ requested: true, requestId, permission }`: a higher role (or an admin) decides.

item.name: POST /social/chat/staff/gifts — Switch sending money on or off

request.description: "Disable / Enable Sending Money from Chat", for everyone. In REPORT mode the answer is `{ requested: true, requestId, permission }`: a higher role (or an admin) decides.
`TO_RESOLVE` (default): pending requests of lower roles this member may resolve. `MINE`: their own.

item.name: POST /social/chat/staff/requests/{requestId}/resolve — Approve or reject a request

request.description: Approving carries the action out as the approver, with their own permissions and limits; the requester gets a notice.

The same commands as typing them in `send_message`: /help, /dm (/pm), /mute, /unmute, /mutelist, /block, /unblock, /blocklist, /send (/gift), /ad. Checked chat-wide, per room (`allowCommands` and its list) and against RESTRICT_COMMANDS.
/mute: their public messages are hidden from you; DMs still work.
/unmute.
/block: their public messages are hidden from you; neither can DM or gift the other; they cannot open your profile.
/unblock.
/mutelist, newest first.
/blocklist, newest first.

item.name: GET /social/chat/ads/options — What an ad can have

request.description: For the ad composer: ads on or off, the badges and skins to choose from (with the skin price), length, link, pinned and repeat limits and the base price.
Validates the ad against the `ads` settings and prices it (base, rooms, links, repeats with discount, pinned minutes) without storing anything.
Pays through the payment module, posts an AD message into each room (never hidden by mute or block, shown to promo-only viewers), queues pinned slots and schedules repeats.
With price breakdown, posts made, next repeat and refunds.
"Separate Advertisement Tab": running ads the viewer's country may see.
Posts not made and pinned minutes not shown are refunded.

item.name: GET /social/chat/rooms/{roomId}/pinned-ad — The pinned ad of a room

request.description: The ad pinned on top of the room now, if any (also sent as `ad_pinned` / `ad_unpinned` and with every join).

item.name: GET /social/chat/gifts/options — What a gift can be

request.description: For the gift form: sending money on or off, the USD limits, the per-currency limits and which code is asked (PAYMENT_PIN or TWO_FA).
/send or /gift: checks, quote and limits, then waits for the payment PIN or 2FA (`verification`). Confirm within 10 minutes.
The code, then the transfer, then the notice in the room or conversation; the recipient gets `gift_received`.

item.name: POST /social/chat/gifts/{giftId}/cancel — Cancel a gift waiting for its code

request.description: PRIMARY (default), GENERAL, GROUPS, CHANNELS (the public groups: "Channels: All Public Groups") or REQUESTS; pinned people first on the first page, then by last activity. Online / last seen follow each user's privacy.
Finds or creates the one conversation with this user; folders follow "Auto Assign Folders"; a stranger gets a message request. Counts toward the new-DM limit.
Conversations with unread messages per folder (channels are the public groups among groups), and pending requests.

Chat MAIN "SO / Merchants: … sorted separately by apps": the merchant folder's conversations and unread per app (appId null = no app). List one app with GET /social/chat/dm/conversations?folder=MERCHANT&appId=…
My settings in it, its members (with read positions and presence) and the group.
Newest first; group members see the group from when they joined.
Text or media (with caption). Links only between friends; groups follow "members can text" and timeouts.
Read receipts: the position only moves forward; the others get `dm_read`.
The conversation moves to General.
Hidden from the inbox; the sender is not told.

item.name: POST /social/chat/dm/conversations/{conversationId}/folder — Move to Primary or General

request.description: "User can switch friends onto general or primary".

item.name: POST /social/chat/dm/conversations/{conversationId}/pin — Pin or unpin a person

request.description: At most "Maximum Number of Pinned People" per folder.
Friends only; `null` removes it.
"Inbox wise": DEFAULT follows the folder setting.
"see all the shared links and media (photos and videos)".

item.name: GET /social/chat/dm/conversations/{conversationId}/members — Members of a group, one page

request.description: One page of a group's members (default 50, at most 100, `nextCursor`).
Starts a gift to the other member; confirm with POST /social/chat/gifts/{giftId}/confirm.
A gift card for the other person of an accepted direct conversation (V2-99): title and value, never the code.
Others see that it was retracted; admins still see the text.

item.name: POST /social/chat/dm/messages/{messageId}/pin — Pin or unpin a message

request.description: Either member of a direct conversation; sub-admins and above in a group. At most "Maximum Number of Pinned Messages (per DM)".
Into up to 10 conversations, marked "Forwarded".
Shows in the staff and admin report queues.
"Users can also search DMs for specific texts".

item.name: GET /social/chat/dm/privacy — My privacy and notification settings

request.description: Last seen and common-groups visibility, folder notifications and quiet mode, over the admin defaults.

item.name: PUT /social/chat/dm/privacy — Change privacy and notification settings

request.description: Custom quiet-mode times only when the admin allows it.
As the other user's "Common Groups … who can see" allows.

item.name: GET /social/chat/dm/users/{userId} — Find a user to message

request.description: Resolves an id, username or login code to the user a conversation can be opened with.
Public (anyone joins) or private (invite only); "Maximum Groups a User Can Create", separate for premium. Invited users get an invite.
"Channels: All Public Groups", with a name search.
Name, description, logo and type, each behind its group permission; "members can text" for admins.
Owner only: the lowest role for each permission, among those the admin lets owners delegate.
Public groups, or private ones with a pending invite.
An owner transfers ownership first.
Needs ADD_PEOPLE; blocked users and banned members are skipped.

item.name: POST /social/chat/dm/invites/{inviteId}/answer — Accept or decline an invite

request.description: Withdraws a pending invite (V2-121).
ADMIN, SUB_ADMIN or MEMBER, below your own; "Max Group Admins / Sub-Admins".
Needs REMOVE_PEOPLE.
"Timeout User (They cannot text)"; `minutes: null` ends it.

item.name: POST /social/chat/dm/groups/{groupId}/members/{userId}/ban — Ban or unban a member

request.description: "Ban User (for public groups)".

item.name: POST /social/chat/dm/groups/{groupId}/messages/{messageId}/delete — Delete a message for members

request.description: "Delete Messages (only deleted on user end)": admins still see it in the panel.
Owner only. The group changes hands at once; no code is asked (V2-144).
The caller's own groups (the GROUPS folder of the inbox), newest activity first.
The group with my membership, its members (with presence) and its settings.
"Settings / Permissions which Group Admins can allow others to set": who may do what in this group.

item.name: GET /social/chat/dm/groups/{groupId}/bans — Banned members of a public group, one page

request.description: Paged list of the people banned from a public group.
Owner, admin, sub-admin or member, within "Max Group Admins / Sub-Admins". Same as the POST form.
Chat MAIN "Support Chat": a new ticket with its first message, PENDING until support answers. A banned user only reads.
Most recently active first; `status` narrows to one tab.

item.name: GET /social/chat/support/tickets/{ticketId} — One ticket and its messages

request.description: The ticket with its conversation, oldest message first; `cursor` pages forward.
A message on a PENDING or OPEN ticket; a CLOSED ticket refuses it (`ticket_closed`).
The close button. A closed ticket takes no more messages.

item.name: GET /social/rain/state — Rainpool countdown and rain rules

request.description: Chat Rainpool Main: the next rain time, when the countdown started, the currency and pot already chosen (in the currency and in USD) for the count-up, each side's ON / OFF / MAINTENANCE status and maintenance text, and the user rain rules (/rain). Public: shown on the dashboard and in chat. Socket: `rain_state`, `rain_config_changed`.

item.name: GET /social/rain/limits — User rain limits of one currency

request.description: Chat SETTINGS "/rain: Minimum / Maximum Amount": the limits of `currency` right now, in that currency (converted from USD when set "Same for all Currencies"), the fee and the recipient limits.
Paid rains everyone may see: Rainpool or user, currency, pot, USD value and how many people.
Rains I made (every state), rains I received (and whether they were reverted), my auto-repeat series still to come, and development balances.

item.name: GET /social/rain/pending — My rains waiting for verification

request.description: RainPool Settings "Security Verifications": what each rain still needs (2FA, the emailed code, the questionnaire without its OK answers, a KYC level), including what an admin requested during a manual review.
Spendable balance per currency. Development wallet only (RAIN_DEV_WALLET); empty while no ledger is connected.

Answers the security verification of a rain: 2FA code, emailed code (Require One / Require Both), questionnaire answers (a wrong answer rejects the rain) and the KYC check. Then the rain is paid, or goes to the manual admin verification (VPN / Proxy rule).

item.name: POST /social/rain/resend-code — Email a new rain code

request.description: Sends a fresh emailed code for a rain still waiting for one.

item.name: POST /social/rain/cancel — Cancel a rain waiting for verification

request.description: Drops a rain that is still waiting for verification. Nothing was debited for it.
Chat MAIN "/rain … (can be set on auto repeat)": stops the rest of one of my auto-repeat series. Runs already paid stay paid.

item.name: POST /social/rain/status — Staff: Disable Overall / Rainpool / User Rains

request.description: Chat SETTINGS "Moderation Role Permissions": DISABLE_OVERALL_RAINS (scope OVERALL), DISABLE_RAINPOOL_RAINS (SYSTEM), DISABLE_USER_RAINS (USER). ACT switches it ON or OFF; REPORT files a staff request with the note.
